passiveBonuses.desc: Cattle can be herded to the Town Center and slaughtered for large amounts of food. Cattle reproduce slowly over time.
Farimba Garrison buildings emit an attack aura to nearby friendly units, granting +15% attack damage in range.

age2.bonus: Stone gathering rate increased by +100%. Stone mines within 15 tiles are automatically revealed on the minimap.
Produces Griot support units that inspire nearby units with attack and movement speed bonuses. Griots also reveal hidden enemies.

age3.bonus: Mosques generate 1.5x gold income from garrisoned Scholars. Each mosque can garrison 2 additional Scholars.
Emits a powerful attack aura buffing all nearby friendly units by +20% attack damage. Can garrison cavalry for enhanced aura.

age4.bonus: Spawns Huntress units periodically. Huntresses are elite archers that can camouflage in forests and deal bonus damage to cavalry.
Villages no longer count against population cap. Each Village produces a free Donso unit upon construction.

uniqueUnits.special: When garrisoned in a Farimba Garrison, emits an extended attack aura to all units within range. Bonus damage to siege equipment.
Cheapest Malian combat unit. Automatically upgrades at 10 kills, gaining +20 HP, +3 attack, and bonus range. Can reach up to 3 upgrade tiers.
Support unit that grants nearby allies +10% attack speed and +5% movement speed. Reveals stealthed units in a 3-tile radius.
Can camouflage in forests, becoming invisible to enemy units. Bonus damage to cavalry. Produced periodically from the Fort of the Huntress.

uniqueTech.effect: Farimba Garrison aura radius increased by 50% and attack bonus increased to +25%.
Donso and Huntress ranged attacks apply a poison that deals 5 damage per second for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
All Donso units start with 1 upgrade tier already applied. Maximum upgrade tier increased to 4.
